scope: language/** and built-ins/** passing execution variants; per-variant execution only (batch compile excluded)

historical.source: canonical per-variant ledger table regenerated from main aa18d9fc docs/results (tools/test262-coverage-ledger.ts --full), 103,264 variants
historical.method:
Rank passing language/** and built-ins/** variants by estimated native execution time.

Input: the per-variant canonical ledger table (--full output of tools/test262-coverage-ledger.ts).
For each passing variant, load the artifact the ledger credited and estimate execution wall time:
  * observation elapsedMs is latency since the variant was enqueued (includes batch compilation);
  * within a batch, execution ~= elapsed(i) - elapsed(previous observation of the same batch);
  * the first observation of a batch has no reliable estimate (its start precedes earlier batches'
    execution) and is counted separately as unestimated.
Diagnostic-pause and resumed-journal rows make deltas unreliable; such rows are flagged.
historical.caveat: Estimates above the 300 s containment come from historical extracts or older journals with resumes/pauses and are not execution times; most rows predate P eval stages 1-3, K call overhead and A3 code size.

currentMain.method: The 200 historically slowest passes (estimate >= 120 s) rerun on a fresh main freeze; executionWallMs = within-batch observation delta (first of each batch unestimated); inferiorCpuSecondsSampled = max ps CPU time of the inferior in 10 s samples (lower bound).
